title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a late‑1973 powerhouse featuring smoking China > Rider, The Other One > Mind Left Body and an unforgettable To Lay Me Down.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean, instrument‑forward mix – piano up in the front, guitars crystal clear and bass “bombing” while vocals sit a little low.  Musically the show shines as one of the band’s late‑’73 highlights, with tight transitions (China > Rider), a monster Other One into Mind Left Body jam, and standout renditions of To Lay Me Down, Dire Wolf, Stella Blue and Tennessee Jed.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviews give 5‑star ratings, highlighting both superb performance and high‑quality soundboard audio; the few lower scores are isolated and do not change the overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Instruments are clean and balanced, piano is prominent, guitars crisp, bass powerful. Vocals are a bit low in the mix; one copy has reduced stereo spread, but overall the sound is clear with no hiss or drop‑outs.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
The Other One > Mind Left Body
poor_songs: I Know You Rider (flub at the ending)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set transitions, especially the China‑Rider pair and a flawless second‑set flow from The Other One into Mind Left Body; the band feels tight yet adventurous throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone praised as crystal clear; noted to be one beat behind during the Mind Left Body jam, sparking discussion about his interplay with Bob.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as “bombing away” and a highlight of the night.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythm guitar leadership shines in the Other One/Mind Left Body segment, adding inventive texture.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano is unusually forward in the mix, giving the keyboards proper presence.
